reddit.title: Explore New Territories in Provincia's Conquest Mode
reddit.body: We're excited to introduce our latest update, which features a new campaign mode in Provincia! In Tutorial 2: Conquest, you will navigate through five unique territories beyond your starting home basin. Each territory presents its own challenges and rewards. Discover how to expand your colony by winning battles and uncovering the map. Dive into the details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
